label: rare: tokens 0/b/q/f/x 1-2 steps after <DEL> or after t/i/j/s (necessary context only)
explanation: Very sparse (about 0.004% of steps, 431 sequences), weak feature (max 0.185). It fires almost only when the input is 0 (55% of mass), b (23%), q, f or x. About 75% of mass is in the copy phase at recall_idx 1-2, i.e. 1-2 steps after <DEL>, usually re-reading original token 1 or 2. The other 25% is in the original phase at t=3-5, after tokens such as t/i/j/s (for example 0 2 j i [f]). Sequences that start with 0 and contain several digits are over-represented. Never fires at t<3, on the delimiter step, or on recall_idx 0 or >=5. These conditions look necessary but are nowhere near sufficient: the best predicate (input in {0,b,q,f,x} with <DEL>/t/i/j/s one or two steps back) recovers 92% of activation mass at 0.06% precision, and even the tightest copy-phase version (recall_idx 1-2 and input 0/b/q) reaches only 0.17% precision. The exact token combination that triggers the feature was not identified. Magnitude did not track any variable we checked.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: in_tok=b (+3.78), orig0=0 (+3.02), phase=2 & out_tok=0 (+2.84), in_tok=q (+2.68), phase=2 & in_tok=0 (+2.61), phase=0 & in_tok=f (+2.50). Lower it: prev_tok=0 (-2.47), prev3_tok=- (-1.73), t=7 (-1.61), n_digits=0 (-1.33).
